title: Synchronization and notification
creator: jens.gerlach
content: At first thank you for Thunderbird for Android! I have installed this App and have some questions. I also think there is a problem with synchronization. New emails are not retrieved on time and emails deleted in the app are not synchronized. This means that they are not deleted in the desktop program. Is there a solution to this? Best regards Jens Gerlach
